[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Offences and Prosecutions
 Section: 275B::Failure to afford facility for inspection of books of account during search.
]


If a person who is required to afford the authorised officer the necessary facility to inspect the books of account or other documents, as required
under clause (iib) of sub-section (1) of section 132, fails to afford such facility to the authorised officer, he shall be punishable with 26[simple imprisonment
for a term up to six months, or with fine, or with both].
